narrative.text: Merchant MID103345 declared home_furnishing at onboarding 109 days ago. Telemetry dissents: the largest deviations from the home_furnishing baseline are velocity_drift at +7.0 sigma (observed 0.52 against a category baseline of -0.00183), round_share_drift at +5.1 sigma (observed 0.103 against a category baseline of 0.00022), velocity_recent at +3.7 sigma (observed 2.29 against a category baseline of 1.65). The checkout surface is consistent with the declared home_furnishing category (0.99 confidence). In total 1 independent view of this merchant contradict its declaration. The investigation used 4 of a permitted 8 steps and stopped because evidence exhausted. Recommended tier is analyst review with settlements continuing, because only one view dissents. A model is 0.98 confident, but only 1 independent view dissents -- model confidence is not evidence agreement, and the action reflects the latter.
